scenario: Temporary browser response fixture mounts the actual built SpoolInventory component and global CSS with a synthetic spool. Deletion confirmation opened without submitting deletion. This measures component appearance; it does not retest authentication or backend routing.

measurements.label: Destructive button
measurements.method: Browser sRGB canvas resolves CSS color spaces and composites the button background over ancestor backgrounds, back to front; WCAG relative luminance uses the resulting 8-bit sRGB pair.

measurements.label: Destructive button hover
measurements.method: Browser sRGB canvas resolves CSS color spaces and composites the button background over ancestor backgrounds, back to front; WCAG relative luminance uses the resulting 8-bit sRGB pair.

supersedes: Earlier destructive normal/hover samples in browser-measurements.json and chrome-measurements.json; the old hover sample was taken without waiting for transitions and used incorrect background composition.
